title_en: Under the Black Water: The Record

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The boards were turned face down before they were sunk.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: They told me it would stop arguments over pay.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: It stopped people proving they had been here.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: Do not scrape them clean. Even a crossed-out letter may be all a family has.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I will bring cloth. Clean cloth this time.
Black water leaves the channel. The earth beneath it keeps the shape of every board.
